registrations.transactionHelp: The one printed on the bank receipt. It cannot be repeated anywhere in the system: that is what prevents crediting the same deposit twice.
registrations.payerHelp: Whoever is named as the holder of the transfer.
registrations.missingNotice: With this amount {{amount}} would still be missing: the registration will be left under review.
registrations.surplusNotice: {{amount}} would be paid in excess, recorded as a credit balance.
registrations.reasonHelp: It is kept in the notes of the registration.
registrations.cancelHelp: The registration stops counting and its place becomes available again. The athlete can register again for the event.
registrations.reactivateHelp: It becomes pending again with a new reservation window. Since expiring or cancelling had released its place, the system checks that the modality still has room and that the athlete has not registered again: if either check fails, the operation is refused.
registrations.bibHelp: Leaving it empty removes the assigned bib. It cannot repeat within the event.
registrations.bibOutOfRange: Bib {{bib}} is outside the range {{from}}–{{to}} of {{modality}}. It can be saved anyway, but it is worth checking.
registrations.confirmedMessage: {{greeting}} {{reference}} is confirmed. See you at the start!
registrations.pendingMessage: {{greeting}} {{reference}} is listed as {{status}}. The balance is {{balance}}. When you transfer, send us the transaction number so we can confirm it.
registrations.batchHelp: It will apply to {{count}} selected registrations. Those not paid, or whose Athlete Portal balance cannot be reverted, are skipped.
